question: Which projects implement or run LLM-scale (or deep-network) inference under zero-knowledge proofs on blockchains, and what can GEODE's M191/M193 privacy track learn from them?
role: Displacement + learning only — an unauthenticated public search cannot support novelty claims (M88). It can find displacing work and teaching material, nothing more.
gate: Anchor gate: every anchor query must return at least one hit after both stages (AND of quoted abs: phrases, then a uniform OR re-run of ALL queries). An anchor that misses voids the search for all claims. A 429 is recorded separately from a genuinely empty result.
